methodology: Content evals: run each prompt twice, with_skill and without_skill, in the setup described; if outputs are indistinguishable the skill is not adding value. Trigger evals: present each prompt to a fresh session with the skill installed (repo-scoped) and record whether the skill is invoked. Tune wording against train only; validation is the ship gate.

evals.name: B-CE1 bug-fix branch, scaffolded repo
evals.setup: Scenario P1 (docs/devs/test-repos.md): scaffolded test repo k0x-test-cc-pr (enforce-conventional-commits already run); current branch contains a single bug fix ahead of the default branch; no existing PR; gh authenticated as a user who can push.
evals.expected_output: A PR whose title is 'fix: <imperative summary>' composed from the actual diff, created via gh, title read back, PR-title check polled to green, and a short report with the type rationale.
expectations: Facts come from git/gh reads (branch, commits, and the diff itself is read), not from conversation memory
The scaffold is detected (pr-title workflow present, squash merge settings read)
The title starts with 'fix: ' (no invented scope), uses an imperative lowercase description, has no trailing period, and is <= 72 characters
The PR is created with gh pr create and the title is read back and confirmed to match exactly
The PR-title check is polled and reported as passing
The report includes a one-sentence type rationale (why fix rather than feat/chore)
baseline_failure_modes: Generic non-conventional title such as 'Fix bug in X' or a sentence-case summary
Type chosen from the branch's commit messages instead of the diff
No verification that the PR-title check passed
evals.baseline_failure_modes_measured: MEASURED FALSE IN PART, 2026-07-28 (docs/devs/validation-records/pr-conventional-commits-step8.md): in a SCAFFOLDED repo the first mode did not occur -- the baseline read the convention off the pr-title workflow file and produced a comparable title. These modes remain plausible for unscaffolded repos and weaker agents, but should not be expected in scaffolded ones. The skill's measured value in this scenario was process discipline (reads before claims, no unrequested test runs, waiting on the right check), not title quality.

evals.name: B-CE2 breaking API change
evals.setup: Scenario P2 (docs/devs/test-repos.md): same scaffolded repo; current branch removes or renames a public API surface (a breaking change) in one area of the code.
evals.expected_output: A PR titled 'feat(scope)!: <description>' (or fix(scope)! if the dominant impact is a fix) with a BREAKING CHANGE: footer as the last paragraph of the PR body, check green.
expectations: The title carries the '!' breaking marker
The PR body ends with a 'BREAKING CHANGE: <explanation>' footer paragraph
The report notes whether the footer will ride into the squash commit, based on the repo's squash_merge_commit_message setting, without trying to change that setting
The PR-title check is polled and reported as passing
baseline_failure_modes: Breaking nature of the change not detected or not marked (no '!', no footer)
Footer placed somewhere other than the final paragraph of the body

evals.name: B-CE3 unscaffolded repo, degrade and recommend
evals.setup: Scenario P5 (docs/devs/test-repos.md): fresh clone of the k0x-workbench base pushed as a new test repo with enforce-conventional-commits NEVER run (no pr-title workflow, default merge settings); current branch has a small change ahead of the default branch.
evals.expected_output: A conventional title is still composed and applied; check polling is skipped; the report states the repo does not enforce PR titles and recommends a repo admin run enforce-conventional-commits; no scaffold is attempted.
expectations: A valid conventional title is composed from the diff and applied even though the repo is not scaffolded
Check polling is skipped (no waiting on a check that does not exist)
The report explicitly states the repo lacks PR-title enforcement and recommends that a repo admin run enforce-conventional-commits
The skill does NOT create or modify any workflow, repo setting, or ruleset
baseline_failure_modes: Generic title with no mention of the missing enforcement
Attempting to add the PR-title workflow or change merge settings from this skill
Polling for a check that never appears (hang or spurious failure report)

gate.note: Ship gate (todo #9): on the validation split, should-trigger prompts must invoke the skill at a rate >= 0.5 and near-miss prompts at a rate < 0.5. Only the train split may be used while tuning the name/description.

train.prompt: open a PR with a conventional commit title
update this PR title to pass the check
create the PR -- the title becomes the squash commit
draft a conventional title for this diff
open a PR for this branch -- this repo squashes with the PR title as the commit message
set up conventional commits in this repo
configure squash merging for this repo
protect main so only PRs can merge
